_comment: The App Store screenshots, one entry each: what it shows and the stage.sh variables that stage it (SCOPE/GALLERY/TAB/CAMERA/CALENDAR/PHOTO/PINS/SELECT/SHEET). `stage_<lang>` would override per language; `{instance}` is the instance below, or INSTANCE= from the environment. `store` is the carousel order; shoot.sh walks `capture` order and stages each shot by relaunching the app, so nothing is set up by hand. A `by_hand` note pauses the capture for something that still is. The values stage photos.misaki.fi's Daily B/W gallery as its read-only guest account sees it (stage.sh signs in as guest by default); a map selection must be a photo that stands alone at the shot's zoom, or MapKit shows no callout. See SCREENSHOTS.md.

map.title: Every photo on the map
map.about: The hero: a city's worth of photo pins and piles, one opened to its thumbnails. Where the diary has been, at a glance.
